newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 4.

text.p: * PepsiCo Inc was down 1/4 at 33-7/8 in London.
The company is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.32, compared to $0.35 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 34-1/8 in New York Monday.

* Colgate-Palmolive Co was up 3/8 at 96-5/8 in London. The company is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.19, compared to $0.80 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 96-1/4.
* Sprint Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.69, compared to $0.79 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 40-1/4.
* Ryder System Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.37, compared to $0.71 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 28-5/8.
* Cisco Systems Inc is expected to report second quarter earnings per share of $0.50, compared to $0.32 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 68-1/4.
* U S West Communications Group is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.60, flat with a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 32-1/4.
* Rubbermaid Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.15, compared to $0.16 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 23-5/8.
* WMX Technologies Inc was up 5/8 at 36-3/4 in London after announcing a 50 million share repurchase program and a new business strategy that includes the divestiture of $1.5 billion of assets.
